analysis.summary: Indo Tech Transformers Limited reported robust financial and operational results for FY2026, highlighted by ₹782 Cr in revenue and ₹93 Cr in PAT. Management outlined a phased capacity-expansion plan aiming to reach 50,000 MVA by FY29 with an investment of ₹495 Cr. The company's executable order book stood at ₹1,318 Cr alongside strong utilization levels of 80-90%. Furthermore, financial resilience was underscored by near-zero net debt, improved debtor days of 56, and cash balances exceeding ₹114 Cr. Indo Tech Transformers Limited presented its full-year FY2026 results and Q1 FY2026-27 update, highlighting growth in revenue to ₹782 Cr and PAT to ₹93 Cr.
